issue.title: no output on `gh auth login`
issue.body: ### Describe the bug No response to login. I'm on a server, have no browsers installed and no UI. First after a key/enter it will shown. ### Affected version Please run `gh version` and paste the output below. gh version gh version 2.75.0 (2025-07-09) https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/tag/v2.75.0 ### Steps to reproduce the behavior 1. Type this '...' 2. View the output '....' 3. See error ### Expected vs actual behavior Output the Code and Login url as on other systems. ### Logs Paste the activity from your command line. Redact if needed.

comments.author: williammartin
comments.body:
Super strange. Can you provide the text output of `GH_DEBUG=1 gh auth login`. This should give a little insight into the commands that are running. There's very little that `gh` does between showing:

```
? What is your preferred protocol for Git operations on this host? HTTPS
```

and the next line:

```
? How would you like to authenticate GitHub CLI? Login with a web browser
```

Also, I don't understand what you mean by:

> First after a key/enter it will shown.

Can you explain, thanks!

comments.author: Dexus
comments.body: Its all i can say. I had to press a key to show the link to connect the device with my account.

comments.author: williammartin
comments.body: Ok that's what I _thought_ you meant but it seemed wild. I have no mental model for what might be happening here.

comments.author: williammartin
comments.body: If you have `tmux` or `screen` could you try running `gh auth login` in there and see if you experience the same behavior?

comments.body: @gwd666, can you please share the list of env vars (redact all needed), and also tell us what OS are you using? Please specify if you're using any special hardware/virtualisation tech or tool (e.g. WSL, VirtualBox, etc).

comments.author: williammartin
comments.body:
Hey @Dexus,

Thanks for all the detail you've shared here.

I'm going to close this because I haven't been able to reproduce it and I think it's a configuration issue. I had another look at your screenshots and I do have a best guess.

### My Best Guess

I don't think `gh` is hanging. The rows where the `? Where do you use GitHub?` question and your answers should be are blank, but the options under them render fine. I suspect your terminal is drawing some prompts invisibly while `gh` waits for
